# Zasim Mallik — Software Engineer & AI SaaS Founder

> Zasim Mallik is a self-taught Software Engineer and AI SaaS Founder from Bangladesh. He is the Founder of **Zeraql** and **Rizmiq**, specializing in full-stack TypeScript (React, Next.js, Node.js), Python (FastAPI), relational/vector databases (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Prisma), and production AI engineering (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini, LangChain, LangGraph, RAG, MCP).

## Quick Facts

- **Name:** Zasim Mallik
- **Role:** Software Engineer | Founder of Zeraql & Rizmiq
- **Location:** Natullabad, Barisal, Bangladesh
- **Experience:** 4+ years building full-stack web applications and AI-powered SaaS products

## Ventures Founded

- **Zeraql** (https://zeraql.com): AI-powered SaaS platform (In Development), architected and developed end-to-end by Zasim Mallik.
- **Rizmiq** (https://rizmiq.com): AI-powered SaaS & developer platform (Beta Launching), architected and developed end-to-end by Zasim Mallik.

## Core Technical Stack

- **Languages:** TypeScript, JavaScript (ES6+), Python, SQL, HTML5, CSS3
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js (App Router, Server & Client Components), Tailwind CSS, Responsive Design
- **Backend & Auth:** Node.js, Express.js, FastAPI, REST APIs, Clerk, NextAuth / Auth.js, OAuth, JWT, Stripe
- **Databases:** PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Redis, Prisma ORM, Vector Databases
- **AI & LLM Engineering:** OpenAI API, Claude API, Gemini API, Context Engineering, AI Agents, RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation), LangChain, LangGraph, MCP (Model Context Protocol)
- **DevOps & Cloud:** Docker, Git, GitHub, CI/CD, Nginx, AWS, Vercel, Railway, Render
- **System Design:** Software Architecture, System Design, API Design, Database Design, SaaS Architecture, Microservices

## Career Timeline

1. **Founder & AI SaaS Developer — Zeraql & Rizmiq (2025 – Present):** Leading end-to-end product engineering on two AI-driven SaaS platforms, from ideation and LLM orchestration to full-stack development and production infrastructure.
2. **Full-Stack Web Developer — Independent (2024 – Present):** Owning full-stack client and independent products end-to-end using React, Next.js, Node.js, PostgreSQL, and Prisma.
3. **Junior Frontend Developer — Programming Hero (2022 – 2023):** Built responsive, accessible web interfaces and maintainable frontend architectures.
